Playstyle_Description: Stealth assassin who blends combat prowess with digital infiltration. Excels at eliminating single targets undetected.
Signature_Ability: Shadow Veil (30s full invisibility + guaranteed crit on first strike)
Lore_Notes: The Shadowblade discipline was developed in the Neon Sprawl by Drifter operatives who needed to survive Syndicate enforcers.

Playstyle_Description: Digital warfare specialist who hacks systems, controls drones, and rewrites reality through the MiraOS.
Signature_Ability: Neural Overdrive (triple processing speed for 20s, jack into any system remotely)
Lore_Notes: Born from the first generation of citizens who could interface directly with the Miraverse's digital layer.

Playstyle_Description: Master of void and arcane energies. Channels dimensional power into devastating spells and protective barriers.
Signature_Ability: Arcane Surge (channel all MAG into single AOE blast; 60s cooldown)
Lore_Notes: Arcanists first appeared after the Void Rift Incident, when some survivors discovered they could channel Rift energy directly.

Playstyle_Description: Master negotiator and political operative. Resolves conflicts through words, favors, and carefully placed information.
Signature_Ability: Silver Tongue (force NPC dialogue check success for 60s; cannot be used in combat)
Lore_Notes: Diplomats are trained in the Citadel's Republic academies. Their skills are equally effective in boardrooms and battlefields.

Playstyle_Description: Biological and digital augmentation specialist. Modifies themselves and allies with cutting-edge Voss Collective tech.
Signature_Ability: Bio-Sync Cascade (apply all active bio-mods to entire party for 45s)
Lore_Notes: Created by the Voss Collective to field-test experimental augmentations. Bio-Engineers blur the line between human and machine.

Playstyle_Description: Frontline heavy combatant who inspires allies and crushes enemies through sheer force of will and physical power.
Signature_Ability: Battle Cry (all nearby allies gain STR +10 and damage immunity for 8s; 90s cooldown)
Lore_Notes: The Warlord path is the oldest career in the Miraverse, predating even the First Collapse. The Ironveil Empire reveres them.

Playstyle_Description: Dimensional traveler who exists between realities. Can phase through walls, see across the Void, and summon rift entities.
Signature_Ability: Void Step (teleport anywhere in current zone instantly; 45s cooldown)
Lore_Notes: Only those touched by Void energy during the Rift Incident can truly walk this path. The Void Walkers teach it to very few outsiders.

Playstyle_Description: Economic empire builder who controls markets, bribes enemies, and wins wars with gold instead of steel.
Signature_Ability: Market Monopoly (control all item prices in current region for 1 hour; massive currency gain)
Lore_Notes: Born from the merchant dynasties of Port Mira. The Merchant Prince career treats every interaction as a transaction.

Playstyle_Description: Master explorer and survivalist who maps uncharted territories and unlocks regions others cannot access.
Signature_Ability: Trailblaze (unlock any locked fast travel hub instantly; reveal entire region map)
Lore_Notes: Pathfinders follow in the tradition of the Dawnrider scouts. Their maps have won more battles than any army.

Playstyle_Description: Engineer-mage who crafts custom weapons, mechanical constructs, and enchanted devices from salvaged components.
Signature_Ability: Construct Deploy (summon a combat-ready mechanical construct for 3 minutes)
Lore_Notes: Artificers emerged from the Undervault's Architect order, fusing pre-Collapse engineering with post-Collapse arcane energy.

Playstyle_Description: Scholar-adventurer who unlocks ancient knowledge, translates dead languages, and weaponizes history.
Signature_Ability: Ancient Revelation (instantly reveal all lore, secrets, and hidden quests in current region)
Lore_Notes: Trained by House Solenne in the Verdant Archive. Lore Keepers are the living memory of the Miraverse.

Playstyle_Description: Ultimate stealth operative who exists as a ghost in every system — no records, no trace, no witnesses.
Signature_Ability: Phantom Cloak (complete invisibility + system ghost status for 60s; AI enemies cannot detect)
Passive_Bonus: All tracking systems blind to player
Lore_Notes: Ghosts are trained by the Phantom Bureau. They are legally erased individuals who weaponize their nonexistence.

Playstyle_Description: Mind-bender who reads thoughts, controls enemies, and projects consciousness across the digital layer.
Signature_Ability: Mind Shatter (stun all enemies in range for 10s + force surrender on humanoids)
Lore_Notes: Psionics emerged when the first Netrunners pushed their neural interfaces too far, awakening latent abilities no one expected.

Playstyle_Description: Nature warrior who bonds with Miraverse creatures and commands them in battle.
Signature_Ability: Alpha Call (summon pack of 3 bonded creatures; creatures gain +50% power for 30s)
Lore_Notes: Taught by the Root Covenant as a means of defending Rootveil from industrial incursion. Beastmasters treat all creatures as kin.

Playstyle_Description: Rapid-fire ranged specialist who overwhelms enemies with speed, trick shots, and explosive rounds.
Signature_Ability: Bullet Storm (fire 20 rounds in 3s with 100% accuracy; ignores armor for duration)
Lore_Notes: A career born from the Imperial sharpshooter corps. Many Gunslingers defect to the Drifters, taking their skills with them.

Playstyle_Description: Combat medic and field surgeon who keeps allies alive under any conditions and weaponizes medical knowledge.
Signature_Ability: Emergency Revival (instantly revive all downed allies to 50% HP; 120s cooldown)
Lore_Notes: Medics were created by the Voss Collective but are welcomed by all factions — even enemies rarely fire on a confirmed Medic.

Playstyle_Description: Pure digital warfare specialist who disables systems, steals data, and weaponizes the MiraOS itself.
Signature_Ability: System Collapse (shut down all electronic systems in current zone for 30s)
Lore_Notes: Hackers are the chaotic edge of Netrunning — less precision, more destruction. The Syndicate recruits them; the Drifters create them.

Playstyle_Description: Dark magic specialist who draws power from forbidden void energies and sacrifices for devastating effects.
Signature_Ability: Soul Drain (absorb life force from all nearby enemies; refill own HP and MAG fully)
Lore_Notes: Warlocks walk a line the Void Walkers consider dangerous. They take more from the Void than they give back — and the Void remembers.

Playstyle_Description: Tactical battlefield leader who coordinates entire teams, issues strategic orders, and turns squads into weapons.
Signature_Ability: Tactical Command (all party members act simultaneously for 15s; AP costs halved)
Lore_Notes: The Commander career is taught exclusively in Imperial War Colleges but its skills apply to any conflict.

Playstyle_Description: Pure survival generalist who excels in every environment but masters none — the ultimate improviser.
Signature_Ability: Adapt (copy the last ability used by any NPC or player for 60s)
Lore_Notes: The Drifter career is the oldest free path in the Miraverse. No house, no faction, no allegiance — just survival and freedom.
